bracketsContent = "_"

totalLength = len(tempStr)

index = 0
while index < totalLength:
    ch = tempStr[index]
    if ch == '(':
        startIdx = index
    elif ch == ')':
        bracketsContent += tempStr[startIdx + 1:index] + "_"
        tempStr = tempStr[:startIdx] + "_" + tempStr[index + 1:]
        totalLength = len(tempStr)
        index = startIdx - 1
        startIdx = -1
    index += 1

bracketParts = bracketsContent.split("_")
bracketCount = sum(1 for part in bracketParts if part)

segmentsArray = tempStr.split("_")

print(f"{maxSegmentLength} {bracketCount}")
